 6 more die of dengue, 2,088 hospitalised in 24 hours
 Death toll rises to 348 
 Published : 18 October 2026
 • 
 Updated : 18 October 2026, 17:35
 • 
 DISEASE
 SHARE 
 Star Online Report 
 At least six dengue patients died and 2,088 others were hospitalised in 24 hours till 8:00am today, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
 Of the deaths, two each were reported in Dhaka North City Corporation (DNCC) and Dhaka South City Corporation (DSCC), while one each was reported in Dhaka and Sylhet divisions.
 Tap here to add The Daily Star as a trusted source 
 With the latest deaths and cases, the death toll rose to 348 and the total number of cases to 112,400.
 Currently, 6,026 dengue patients are undergoing treatment at hospitals across the country.
